G2.test: delete every class in turn; same positive Pearson permutation plus LOO S

G3.test: Freedman-Lane reduced y~1+year residual permutation; full y~1+year+x; one-sided x-coefficient t

classification.MODERATE: G1 AND exactly one of G2/G3
classification.WEAK: G1 AND neither G2 nor G3

construct.actual: A_c=sum RichHill[k] for frozen actual fantasy rows at selection order k<=60
construct.projected: P_c=sum RichHill[k] for frozen projected fantasy rows at selection order k<=60

downstream_authority.MODERATE: Continue evidence collection; no FV adjustment authority.
downstream_authority.STRONG: May authorize a separate Layer-D/shadow-calibration study only; never direct production.
downstream_authority.WEAK: Continue evidence collection only; no FV adjustment authority.

objective: Execute the single B18-authorized exploratory C1 historical screen without changing construct, gates, thresholds, or downstream authority.
one_shot_semantics: A committed C1 result closes the gate. A runner failure before commit may replay only this exact deterministic contract and exact hashed inputs; it cannot create a different scientific result.

predictive_utility.model: LOO clipped OLS y=a+b*x with b=max(0, OLS slope) inside each training fold

seed_derivation_note: Deterministic non-overlapping C1 seed allocation from B18 permutation_bank_base=180000; frozen here before any historical P_c/A_c scalar or association is computed.
